commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' A cross from the corner kick arrives at the feet of Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin), giving him an opportunity to shoot. He misses completely, well to the left of the goal.
90+4' The ball goes behind for a corner. Union Berlin will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+3' David Raum (RB Leipzig) fires the resulting free kick to the bottom left corner from the edge of the box, but Frederik Ronnow pulls off a superb save to deny him.

90+1' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. RB Leipzig earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
88' Alexander Zickler has decided to make a change. El Chadaille Bitshiabu (RB Leipzig) replaces Lutsharel Geertruida.
88' It's time for a substitution. Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) comes on in place of Kevin Kampl.
85' What was Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
84' Babak Keyhanfar is stunned as referee Sven Jablonski shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
82' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) outjumped his marker after a well-taken corner, but his header goes wide of the target.
82' Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
81' Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
81' It will be a substitution. Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) is ready to enter the pitch as Tom Rothe walks off.

79' The manager makes a subsitution with Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) coming on for Benjamin Henrichs.
76' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from RB Leipzig comes to nothing.

74' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) blows a huge chance to score! He sends the penalty to the bottom left corner, but it's not enough to beat Frederik Ronnow who easily stops the effort. The ball is out of play. RB Leipzig will have a chance to score from a corner.
74' The referee Sven Jablonski awards Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) a yellow card.
74' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) is going to take the penalty!
74' The attendance for today's match is 45000.
73' Kevin Vogt (Union Berlin) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. The referee's verdict is crystal clear. A penalty is awarded to RB Leipzig!
69' Babak Keyhanfar has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) replacing Benedict Hollerbach.
68' RB Leipzig take a short corner kick.

68' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) tries his luck from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort, but it is well blocked by the defender. The ball goes out for a corner. RB Leipzig can continue in their attacking effort.

62' David Raum (RB Leipzig) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
61' Sven Jablonski shows a yellow card to Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) for a tough tackle.
59' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the right post is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
59' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Union Berlin.

58' What a great chance for Tom Rothe (Union Berlin). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header right under the bar, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save.
58' The referee signals a corner kick to Union Berlin.
58' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
56' Babak Keyhanfar has decided to substitute Laszlo Benes and he is replaced by Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin).
56' Substitution. Jordan Siebatcheu (Union Berlin) on for Tim Skarke.
56' Golden opportunity! Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) lost his marker inside the box, only to shoot just wide of the left post after receiving a good pass.
54' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
54' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
53' The foul by Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Sven Jablonski.
50' Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) is flagged for offside.

47' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
47' Union Berlin win a corner.
47' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) strikes a volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his effort.
46' The second half has just started.
45+1' The match has reached half-time.
45' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
45' Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
45' RB Leipzig can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
44' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. RB Leipzig will take a corner kick.
41' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Union Berlin.

27' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by RB Leipzig, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
26' Laszlo Benes (Union Berlin) sees a yellow card from Sven Jablonski after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.

21' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score into the bottom left corner, but great anticipation by Frederik Ronnow allowed him to make a comfortable save.
19' Close! Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot narrowly over the bar.
18' David Raum (RB Leipzig) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
18' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by David Raum (RB Leipzig).

17' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) jumps into a tackle and Sven Jablonski signals a foul. A free kick has been awarded to RB Leipzig.
14' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) makes a strong challenge and Sven Jablonski blows for a foul.
13' That was close by Lois Openda (RB Leipzig)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post.
12' The ratio of the ball possession is 78:22.
9' RB Leipzig enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
